name: CoAuthoring
description: Provides the primary entry point to the co authoring object model.
remarks: The CoAuthoring object provides information about co authoring at the document level. For example, the CoAuthoring object can provide information about whether there are any locks in the document, which users have current locks in the document, or whether or not updates to the document content is available from the server. Use the CoAuthoring property to return the CoAuthoring object.
example:
Sub CountLocks()
Dim i As Integer

i = ActiveDocument.CoAuthoring.Locks.Count

MsgBox i

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified CoAuthoring object.

properties.name: Authors
properties.description: Returns a CoAuthors collection that represents all the co authors currently editing the document. Read-only.

properties.name: Me
properties.description: Returns a CoAuthor object that represents the current user. Read-only.

properties.name: PendingUpdates
properties.description: Returns True if the document has pending updates that have not been accepted. Read-only.

properties.name: Locks
properties.description: Returns a CoAuthLocks collection that represents the locks in the document. Read-only.

properties.name: Updates
properties.description: Returns a CoAuthUpdates collection that represents the most recent updates that were merged into the document. Read-only.

properties.name: Conflicts
properties.description: Returns a Conflicts collection that represents all the conflicts in a document. Read-only.

properties.name: CanShare
properties.description: Returns a Boolean that specifies whether this document can be co authored. Read-only.

properties.name: CanMerge
properties.description: Returns a Boolean that specifies whether the document can be auto-merged. Read-only.
